sentinel.issue.reused.description: Credential reuse multiplies blast radius. Split shared passwords into unique logins.
sentinel.issue.old.title: Aging passwords
sentinel.issue.old.description: Long-lived passwords become brittle over time. Rotate these to stay ahead of breaches.

sentinel.recommendations.item.good.title: Great job!
sentinel.recommendations.item.good.descr: Your passwords are strong and unique. Keep up the good security practices.
